errors.text_span: wobei die Beschriftungen jedes zweite Jahr angegeben sind
errors.evidence: The x-axis labels are shown for every single year from 2005 to 2024, not every second year.

errors.text_span: einem Tiefpunkt bei etwa 2,5 % im Jahr 2014
errors.evidence: The low point of the blue line in this period is in 2013 at approximately 2.5%. In 2014, the value is approximately 5%.

errors.text_span: bevor sie bis 2024 auf etwa 3 % absinkt
errors.evidence: The blue line ends at approximately 3.5% in 2024, not 3%.
The blue average line is dashed ('gestrichelt' in German), not dotted ('punktiert').
The purple line begins at approximately 4.5% in 2005, which is visibly halfway between the 3 and 5 tick marks.
The purple line dips below the zero line in 2014 to a value of approximately -0.2%, not 0.5%.
The value of the purple line in 2019 is approximately 3.5%, not 5%.

errors.text_span: und sinkt dann bis 2024 auf etwa 2,5 %
errors.evidence: The purple line ends at or very close to 0% in 2024. The value 2.5% is significantly incorrect and is close to the value of the purple dashed line (2.6%).
The purple average line is dashed ('gestrichelt' in German), not dotted ('punktiert').
